answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
